summary: MathWorks Japan offers advanced solutions like MATLAB and Simulink that facilitate model-based design, ensuring data integrity and consistency in mixed-signal and high-speed digital designs. Their tools improve integration with major EDA tools, optimizing design accuracy and manufacturing processes through simulation and data processing.

Behavioral model export for EDA tools
Simulation and data processing for manufacturing optimization
